# Kaggle ASL Signs

This directory includes the winning entry for the
[ASL Signs](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/asl-signs) Kaggle competition.

Files are from 
- the model from the top solution: https://www.kaggle.com/code/hoyso48/1st-place-solution-inference
- the [ASL vocabulary](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/asl-signs/data?select=sign_to_prediction_index_map.json) of the training data
